SELECT a.StationID AS stationId, (SELECT stationname FROM dbtoms.tbstationinfo WHERE a.StationID = stationid LIMIT 1 ) AS stationName, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DealStatus&14=6 THEN CarNum ELSE 0 END),0) as officialIcCardCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DealStatus&14=8 THEN CarNum ELSE 0 END),0) as militaryIcCardCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DealStatus&14=12 THEN CarNum ELSE 0 END),0) as freeIcCardCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (DealStatus&14!=14 AND DealStatus&14!=2 AND DealStatus&0xE00000!=0x200000 AND DealStatus&0x1000000=0 AND DealStatus&32!=32 AND CardType=0) OR (CardType=26 AND DealStatus&32!=32) THEN CardNum ELSE 0 END),0) as dueIcCardCount, IFNULL(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN PayType=0 THEN TotalToll ELSE 0 END)/100 as DECIMAL(10,2)), 0) AS douTotalToll, IFNULL(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DealStatus&14=4 THEN TotalArrearage ELSE 0 END)/100 AS DECIMAL(10,2)), 0) AS arrearsAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DealStatus&14=4 THEN CarNum ELSE 0 END),0) AS arrearsTrips, IFNULL(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN PayType=16 THEN TotalToll ELSE 0 END)/100 as DECIMAL(10,2)), 0) AS mobilePaymentAmount, IFNULL(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN PayType=2 THEN TotalToll ELSE 0 END) /100 as DECIMAL(10,2)), 0) as ePaymentAmount, LEFT(a.StaDate, 6) AS monthDate, a.StaDate AS staDate FROM
SELECT * FROM ${tableName} AS alias${index + 1}
AND StationID in
#{stationId}
AND StaDate >= #{intBeginTime}
AND StaDate <= #{intEndTime}
AND CancelFlag = 0 AND RecordType &1 =1
a
GROUP BY StaDate
GROUP BY monthDate
GROUP BY StationID
ORDER BY StaDate ASC
ORDER BY monthDate ASC
ORDER BY StationID ASC
